scope: 36 landing concepts; concepts do not imply 36 independent released products

compatibilityPolicy.major: exact supported major; fail closed for unknown versions
compatibilityPolicy.minor: additive only with acceptance and isolation regression
compatibilityPolicy.deprecation: announce replacement and consumer inventory before removal; no silent auth/data downgrade
compatibilityPolicy.migration: expand-contract; preserve tenant and immutable approval evidence
